subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'BREAK' is written as '2182111' and 'COLOUR' is written as '34124518'. How will 'TRING' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Consonants - Position value to the English alphabetic series is written.
 
• Vowels - Coded in a serial order according to the English alphabetic series i.e :
 
 
• A → 1
 
• E → 2
 
• I → 3
 
• O → 4 
 
• U → 5 
 
 

​So,

 
• 'BREAK' is written as '2182111'​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4569bb98b312e6714c7eb8e4e9ca6970241cf3fede315fb263f1ff2adf445b9a.png] 

​And,

 
• 'COLOUR' is written as '34124518'​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/802834ed6de5293e72612053c6776f91afedcfee54ee4463e0ecdd584f1712c3.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'TRING' is written as :​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a54fd2e298ea33d73085a193dbe570e69627504c0e9afd9d66a3d2fbbc9394bc.png] 

Hence, "**20183147**" is the correct answer.
